1. Owned asset holding: Propiedad ≈ "Property"! | Inmueble ≈ Im-mobile (unmovable land/buildings = Real Estate)!
2. Bare ground plot: Terreno ≈ "Terrain"! | Lote / parcela ≈ "Lot / Parcel" of land!
1435.shortcutHi:

1435.hiDevanagari: 1. Owned asset holding: Property / jaaydaad | 2. Bare ground plot: Plot / zameen ka tukda

1436.exampleEn: Call your apartment landlord if the heating boiler stops working properly.
1436.shortcutHi: Makaan-maalik ≈ Makaan (House) + Maalik (Tamil மாலிக் / உரிமையாளர் = Owner!) → Owner of the house = Landlord!

1437.exampleEn: The new apartment tenant pays monthly rent directly via electronic bank
1437.shortcutEs: Inquilino ≈ Sounds like "In-Key-Living" → Person living inside with the house key = Tenant! | Arrendatario ≈ From Renta (Rent) → Lease-paying Renter!
1437.shortcutHi: Kirayedaar ≈ Kiraya (Rent — Tamil கிரயம் = Price/Payment) + -daar (Holder/Payer) → Rent-payer living in your flat = Tenant!

trans.es: 1. Monthly occupancy fee: Alquiler / renta | 2. Contract tenure term: Contrato de arrendamiento

1438.exampleEn: Pay your apartment housing rent on the first day of every month.
1438.shortcutEs:
1. Monthly occupancy fee: Alquiler ≈ Think "All-Key-Hire" (monthly apartment Rent)! | Renta ≈ Direct sibling of English "Rent"!
2. Contract tenure term: Contrato de arrendamiento ≈ "Contract" of renting/leasing = Lease Agreement!
1438.shortcutHi:
1. Monthly occupancy fee: Kiraya ≈ From Tamil கிரயம் (Kirayam = Fare/Fee!) → Monthly flat rent or cab fare!
2. Contract tenure term: Lease ≈ Standard Indian property/rental contract term!
1438.hiDevanagari: 1. Monthly occupancy fee: Kiraya | 2. Contract tenure term: Lease

1439.exampleEn: They saved for five years to afford a twenty percent house downpayment.
1439.shortcutEs: Pago inicial ≈ Initial Payment! | Anticipo ≈ "Anticipate" (upfront advance)! | Enganche ≈ Hook/lock in a car or house deal with upfront cash = Downpayment!
1439.shortcutHi: Downpayment / advance ≈ Both standard English banking terms are used directly in everyday Hindi when buying a home, bike, or booking a flat!

1440.exampleEn: Home ownership provides long-term financial security and family stability.
1440.shortcutEs:
1. Possession status right: Propiedad ≈ "Property"! | Titularidad ≈ Holding official "Title"!
2. Written title registry: Escritura ≈ "Scripture / Script" (signed legal paper)! | Título de propiedad ≈ Title of property = Deed!
1440.shortcutHi:
1. Possession status right: Haq ≈ Spoken Tamil ஹக் (Hakku = Rightful claim!) → Legal ownership right!
2. Written title registry: Registry ≈ Universal Indian real-estate word ("Plot ki registry" = Recorded property Deed)!
1440.hiDevanagari: 1. Possession status right: Haq | 2. Written title registry: Registry

1441.shortcutEs: Compañero de piso / de cuarto ≈ Compañero ("Companion") + de Piso (Flat/Floor) or de Cuarto (Room/"Quarter") = Flatmate / Roommate!
1441.shortcutHi: Room-partner / flatmate ≈ Both crisp English compound terms are used directly across Indian hostels and shared apartments!

1442.category: Category 91: Living Spaces, Accommodation & Home Utilities
1442.exampleEn: Book your hotel holiday accommodation several weeks in advance during
1442.shortcutHi: Rehne ki jagah ≈ Rehne (Living) + ki Jagah (Place) = Place to stay / Accommodation! | Makaan ≈ Built house structure / Residence!

trans.es: 1. Fitted with furniture: Amueblado | 2. Empty bare walls: Sin amueblar / vacío

1443.tamil: பொருட்கள் கொண்ட வீடு (ஃபர்னிஷ்டு) / பொருட்கள் இல்லாத வீடு
1443.exampleEn: We rented a fully furnished studio apartment complete with a bed and sofa.
1443.shortcutEs:
1. Fitted with furniture: Amueblado ≈ From Muebles ("Mobile" goods = Furniture) → Ready with sofa & bed = Furnished!
2. Empty bare walls: Sin amueblar ≈ Sin (Without) furniture! | Vacío ≈ "Vacant / Vacuum" = Bare empty!
1443.shortcutHi:
1. Fitted with furniture: Furnished / saamaan ke saath ≈ English "Furnished" or Saamaan (Stuff — Tamil சாமான்!) + ke Saath (With)!
2. Empty bare walls: Bina saamaan ka / khaali ≈ Bina (Without) + Saamaan (Tamil சாமான்) | Khaali (Tamil காலி = Empty!)!
1443.hiDevanagari: 1. Fitted with furniture: Furnished / saamaan ke saath | 2. Empty bare walls: Bina saamaan ka / khaali

1444.category: Category 91: Living Spaces, Accommodation & Home Utilities
1444.exampleEn: Monthly utility bills for electricity, heating, water, and garbage
1444.shortcutEs: Servicios básicos ≈ Basic Services (power, water, gas)! | Facturas (luz, agua, gas) ≈ Monthly house "Factor/Bills" (light, water, gas)!
1444.shortcutHi: Bijli-paani ke kharche ≈ Bijli (Electricity) + Paani (Water) + Kharche (Expenses — Tamil செலவு)! | Bills ≈ Spoken daily for utility invoices!

1445.category: Category 91: Living Spaces, Accommodation & Home Utilities
1445.exampleEn: Regular building roof maintenance prevents water leaks during heavy rain
1445.shortcutHi: Dekhbhaal ≈ Dekh (Watch/Look) + Bhaal (Care) = Regular upkeep & Maintenance! | Marammat ≈ Tamil மராமத்து (Maraamatthu = Repair/Upkeep work!) → 100% shared word!

1446.category: Category 91: Living Spaces, Accommodation & Home Utilities
1446.exampleEn: Company expansion to the new regional office required employee family
1446.shortcutEs: Mudanza ≈ From Mudar (Change "Mode"/Home) → Packing boxes to move house = Relocation! | Traslado ≈ Tras- ("Trans-" Across) + Lado (Place) → Transfer across town!
1446.shortcutHi: Ghar badalna ≈ Ghar (Home) + Badalna (Change/Swap) = Moving to a new house! | Shifting ≈ Standard everyday Indian word ("Kal hum new flat mein shifting kar rahe hain")!
